description: Two iterations modeling the machine-fixable end of the loop: a use-after-move on a String used as both map key and container element, which `karac fix` resolves on its own.

responses.note: First attempt. `code` is needed as a LINKS key, a HITS key, an ORDER element and the return value, but is written as if each use were free — the modal mistake for a value-semantics language. E0500 fires; the fix is machine-applicable, so `karac fix` closes it without the LLM re-reasoning. Verified: the fixed program passes the oracle, making this a `fixed-by-karac` + oracle-PASS case — the strong wedge result.
Reference solution, reached if the loop needs a second turn.
